Multiplying both sides of the given equality by x(x+2)3 gives x3+8x2+17x+8=A(x+2)3+Bx(x+2)2+Cx(x+2)+Dx.

Letting x=−2 gives (−2)3+8(−2)2+17(−2)+8=A(−2+2)3+B(−2)(−2+2)2+C(−2)(−2+2)+D(−2)−8+32−34+8=−2D−8+32−34+8=−2D−2=−2DD=1.

Letting x=0 gives 03+8(0)2+17(0)+8=A(0+2)3+B(0)(0+2)2+C(0)(0+2)+D(0)8=8AA=1.

Letting x=−1 and using our values for A and D gives (−1)3+8(−1)2+17(−1)+8=1(−1+2)3+B(−1)(−1+2)2+C(−1)(−1+2)+1(−1)−1+8−17+8=1−B−C−1B=2−C.(1)

Now, letting x=−3 and using our values for A and D gives (−3)3+8(−3)2+17(−3)+8=1(−3+2)3+B(−3)(−3+2)2+C(−3)(−3+2)+1(−3)−27+72−51+8=−1−3B+3C−33B=3C−6B=C−2.(2)

From (1) and (2) we have 2−C=C−2−2C=−4C=2.

Now we substitute the value of C into (1) to get the value of B: B=2−2=0

Finally, AB+CD=1(0)+2(1)=2.
